alt: Two paper cards. On Paper 1 the Shakespeare question carries 4 extra AO4 marks; on Paper 2 the modern text question does. Below, AO4 rewards range of vocabulary and sentence structures with accurate spelling and punctuation, and clear writing matters everywhere because an argument that cannot be followed cannot be credited.
caption: AO4 is worth 4 marks on two questions, but clear writing carries every answer.

alt: Six purposes are stacked from describe and summarise at the bottom, through explain, argue and analyse, to evaluate at the top, each with its job in an essay and its limit. An arrow points up towards the higher levels, and a note says paragraphs that only describe and summarise have not reached them.
caption: Describe and summarise only set things up; the marks come from explaining, arguing, analysing and evaluating.

alt: Three thesis statements about ambition, from weak (ambition in many ways), to better (attractive at first and destructive by the end), to strongest (a force that isolates the people who pursue it until success and loneliness become the same thing). Below, a good thesis is arguable, specific and covers the whole text.
caption: A thesis should be arguable, specific and cover the whole text.

alt: A weak topic sentence, another theme is guilt, only announces a topic. A stronger one, this isolation deepens once guilt replaces ambition, links back to the previous point and moves the argument forward. Below, four signposting phrases: this develops further when, by contrast, this complicates the earlier view because, and ultimately.
caption: Each topic sentence should link back to the thesis and push it forward.

alt: Two panels contrast many points covered thinly with three or four points in depth, where the key point has the longest paragraph. Below, three ways to emphasise a key point: by order, by space and by language such as most strikingly or crucially.
caption: Fewer points with real depth, and make the key one stand out.

alt: A dropped-in quotation, a whole sentence placed between two statements, is contrasted with an embedded one: the command to get out shows anger turning into control. Below, five conventions: quotation marks, ellipsis, square brackets, a forward slash for line breaks, and underlining titles of plays and novels.
caption: Build short quotations into your own sentences, and follow the conventions.

alt: Register: avoid slang, text-speak and vague words; prefer precise verbs such as suggests, implies, exposes, undermines, reinforces and conveys. Tense: present for the text, past only for historical context. A note on sentence variety gives a complex sentence beginning although.
caption: Formal precise verbs, the present tense for the text, and varied sentences.

alt: The weaker paragraph about a poem, with errors such as their and alot, sits beside the improved one, which presents grief as an absence that fills the home. Below, a checklist of what changed: a clear opening point, an embedded quotation, spelling and grammar fixed, one choice analysed, and an evaluative final sentence.
caption: Five changes turn a vague, error-prone paragraph into an analytical one.
